test_title: PYST 32: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 17 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the appropriate antonym for the underlined word.**

A **__mysterious__** glowing girl has informed him of the death.
solution: The correct answer is **"evident."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"mysterious"** means that you do not understand or cannot explain; strange. (समझने या समझाने से परे; अद्‌भुत, रहस्‍यमय) • **Example**: *Several people reported seeing **mysterious**__ lights in the sky.* • The antonym of **'mysterious' **is** 'evident'.** • **'Evident'** means clear, obvious, and easily noticeable. (स्‍पष्‍ट (दीखने में या सोच में); सुस्‍पष्‍ट, प्रकट) __ • **Example**:* It was **evident**__ that the damage was very serious.* • In the given sentence, the glowing girl's message is mysterious, which means it is unclear and difficult to understand. • Therefore, the opposite of **mysterious** in this context would be evident, as the message would have been clear and easy to understand. • The correct answer is Option 1. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Option 2, **cryptic**, is a synonym of mysterious and means having a meaning that is mysterious or obscure. (गुप्‍त अर्थ वाला; रहस्‍यमय) • Option 3, **critical**, means expressing adverse or disapproving comments or judgments. (दोषदर्शी, आलोचनात्‍मक) • Option 4, **murky**, means dark and gloomy, or obscure and unclear. (अंधकारमय और अप्रिय या मलिन) 41:T69c, The correct answer is **"come to his office on."**
